title: Grade 8 Mathematics — 8.EE.2 coverage correction

refuted_claims.claim: Grade 8 has an inequality-related prerequisite coverage gap.
refuted_claims.basis: Michigan Grade 8 mathematics contains no inequality standard; zero occurrences of 'inequalit' in the Grade 8 section of the official standards document. Inequalities are owned by 6.EE.5, 6.EE.8 and 7.EE.4b, and Grade 7 of this curriculum already covers 7.EE.4 with a dedicated inequalities unit.
refuted_claims.action: none — authoring Grade 8 inequality content would attach instruction to a standard that does not exist at this grade

standards_source.corroboration: SHA-256 is bit-identical to the digest recorded independently in curriculum-authoring/full-family-highschool-9-12/subjects/mathematics/standards/standards-custody.md

id_stability.note: Unit 1 in 1.0.0 ends at l18. New lessons continue the same unit at l19-l21 and satisfy the sealed lesson_id pattern in schemas/lesson.schema.json, so integration requires no renumbering of any existing lesson.

placement.rationale: 8.EE.2's third requirement ('know that √2 is irrational') is Unit 1's core content, and Unit 1 already teaches approximating square roots (8.NS.2) — the approximate counterpart to 8.EE.2's exact-root work. Placement here also precedes Unit 2 (integer exponents) and Unit 8 (Pythagorean theorem), the downstream consumer of root reasoning.

schedule_impact.collision_warning: course_day 19-21 are currently occupied by ma-g8-mathematics-u02-l01..l03 in the sealed release. These overlay values express the intended insertion position, NOT an assertion that the slots are free.
options: SUBSTITUTION (recommended): deliver the three correction lessons in place of three generic-recycle Unit 1 days (l08 reteach, l13 skill consolidation, l14 transfer challenge). Preserves the 180-day model and changes no IDs. This is a delivery-sequencing decision, not a content edit.
EXTENSION: schedule the three lessons as additional days, shifting sealed course_day 19-180 to 22-183. Closes the gap without displacing any sealed lesson, but breaks the 180-day model.
schedule_impact.decision_owner: director — not made by this correction
